newsitem.title: FRANCE: France launches tender for Moroccan debt.
newsitem.headline: France launches tender for Moroccan debt.

text.p: The French finance Ministry launched a tender on October 15 to convert some 400 million francs of Moroccan debt owed to France into private investments, the ministry said on Thursday.
The tender is part of an agreement reached between French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis and Moroccan Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj in January.
Investors are invited to submit bids, through their bank intermediaries, to buy Moroccan debt and must have prior approval from the Moroccan authorities for their projects.
